blocker.current_behavior: Both _source_paths and _sandbox_source_paths build a resolved-path dictionary before validating every candidate occurrence as a regular nonlink. A direct-authority symlink or lexical alias can be overwritten by a later row and disappear before _regular examines it.
blocker.impact: The happy-path source bundle is complete, but the declared nonregular/symlink fail-closed property is not complete.
blocker.minimum_experiment_boundary_relevance: This is deterministic source admission, not a malicious-host or production-isolation residual.

counterevidence_and_reassessment.initial_overbroad_recommendation: Reject every duplicate lexical or resolved declaration.
revised_smallest_component_replacement: Validate every candidate occurrence as a final regular nonlink before any resolve or coalescing.
Normalize a lexical absolute path and require it to remain within the canonical repository.
Resolve strictly and require the resolved path to equal the normalized lexical path, rejecting any symlink-bearing ancestor.
Allow repeated declarations only when the normalized lexical path is identical.
Reject distinct normalized lexical paths that resolve to one target.
Sort and retain one deterministic representative per identical lexical path.
